title: Craft and Table-Top Sale – 5 December
location: Layton Methodist, Westcliffe Drive, Blackpool FY3 7DZ
description: A morning of browsing, chatting and supporting local crafters and sellers, with a cuppa from the café. Proceeds go towards our new Youth and Skills Hub. Saturday 5 December 2026, doors open 9:30am. Layton Methodist, Westcliffe Drive, Blackpool FY3 7DZ. Café open for refreshments. Free entry, everyone welcome. Layton Methodist on Facebook →

title: Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On
location: Layton Square, Westcliffe Drive, Blackpool FY3
description: The Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On, organised by Layton Together and supported by Forward Project and local councillors. Friday 27 November, event from 5:15pm, lights switched on at 6:15pm, on Westcliffe Drive, Layton. Special guests, live music, stalls, a treasure hunt, a book give-away and a brass band. Temporary road closures are in place from 5pm to 7pm.

title: Christmas Market at Christ King Church
location: Christ King Church, 241 Bispham Road, Blackpool FY2 0LB
description: Lots of handmade gifts, unique finds and treats, with something for everyone. A great way to get a head start on your Christmas shopping while supporting local small businesses. Stalls so far include Boo Blooms, Resin by Olivia, Bling by Amy, Inner Sparkle, The Dessert Lab and more, with Mr Whippy Blackpool outside serving ice creams and waffles. Saturday 21 November 2026, 11am-3pm. Free entry.

title: Music & Memory Social at Layton Library
description: A new dementia-inclusive social for older residents, families and carers. Nostalgic songs, cherished memories, gentle singalongs and a lovely brew and a chat. Every Saturday at Layton Library from 28 November 2026, 10:30am-12:30pm. No singing skills needed.

description: A new dementia-inclusive social for older residents, families and carers. Nostalgic songs, cherished memories, gentle singalongs and a lovely brew and a chat. Every Friday at The Grange from 8 January 2027, 11am-1pm. No singing skills needed.

title: 20p Toy Sale at the Re-use Shop
location: Re-use Shop, Bristol Avenue, Bispham (just outside Layton)
description: Enveco is holding a 20p Toy Sale at its Re-use Shop, just outside Layton, with every good-quality pre-loved toy just 20p and up to 10 toys per person. Saturday 12 December, 10:30am-3:30pm at the Re-use Shop, Household Waste Recycling Centre, Bristol Avenue, Bispham, FY2 0JG. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

title: Free Christmas Party at The Victory Pub
location: The Victory Pub, Caunce Street, Blackpool
description: Blackpool Mums & Babies by Ameelia invite everyone to a free Christmas party to say a huge thank you to the community. Free disco, free buffet, free face painting and a free visit from Santa, plus games, dancing and festive fun. Sunday 29 November, 2pm-5pm at The Victory Pub, Caunce Street, Blackpool. Donations welcome, never expected, supporting the Christmas Present Drive and future community activities.

title: Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute
description: Streetlife invite families to a free Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute. Santa's Grotto, Christmas crafts, festive games, Christmas gifts, raffle and tombola, cake stall, hot food and a lucky dip. Sunday 29 November, 1pm-4pm. Free entry, and every penny raised supports Streetlife and the young people they help across Blackpool.

title: Christmas Fayre and Lights Switch On at The Grange
description: A Christmas Fayre with lots of stalls from 12pm at The Grange, followed by the lights switch on at 3:30pm. Tuesday 1 December, The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue, Blackpool.

description: Christmas Bingo at The Grange with some great prizes up for grabs. Friday 4 December, 5pm, eyes down at 5:15pm. Tickets go fast, so be quick. The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue, Blackpool.

description: The Walking Nativity with the local schools arrives at The Grange at 3pm. Tuesday 15 December, The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue, Blackpool.

description: A Christmas Community Meal at The Grange, a place to come along and share in the festive spirit. Tuesday 22 December, 12:30pm, The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue, Blackpool.

title: Festive Express 2026
description: BFriend & Wellbeing, part of Community First, invite local families to Festive Express, a free marketplace-style Christmas event where everything is given away to anyone who wants to browse. Toy station, teen station, Christmas Eve boxes, free gift stalls, gift wrapping while you wait, festive family food ideas, crafts and activities and a free pop-up cafe. Thursday 3 December, 2pm-5:30pm at Forest Gate Baptist Church, Blackpool. No referral or booking needed. Donations of toys, gifts, wrapping supplies, toiletries and long-life food are being collected at Community First, Abingdon Street, until Wednesday 2 December.

title: Christmas Party at Layton Rec Play Park
description: Friends of Layton Rec invite everyone to a magical Christmas celebration with Father Christmas, a bouncy castle, stalls, the Christmas light switch on and lots more fun. Friday 4 December, 5pm onwards at Layton Rec Play Park.

description: A Disney themed Lunch Club at The Grange with a 2 course meal, tea and coffee, classic bingo, guess the song and a fun quiz. Optional fancy dress, so come as your favourite Disney character. Thursday 26 November, 12:30pm. £4 each person. Booking essential, and it must be booked and paid in cash before the day.

title: Retro Games Night at Blackpool Recovery Hub
location: Blackpool Recovery Hub, 258 Church Street, Blackpool
description: Blackpool Recovery Hub invite everyone to a night of retro gaming fun. Dust off those old favourites, bring your competitive side and enjoy a bit of nostalgia, good vibes and great company. Sunday 22 November, 6pm-9pm at Blackpool Recovery Hub, 258 Church Street. Everyone welcome.
